notes.title: “Disease -Hidden Object-” Released on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38506994/b0787b683104dd8053f5fbf3f57343da41ffe1c2.png[/img]

The horror adventure game which became popular on Nintendo Switch now appears on Steam!

Is what you see real or just a hallucination?
A former doctor wanders in two worlds while doubting himself.
